query_analysis.original_query: Our pressure swing adsorption unit experienced a sudden valve failure. How can we assess if this poses a significant safety risk to the surrounding equipment?
query_analysis.expanded_query: Conduct a comprehensive safety risk assessment following an unexpected valve failure in a pressure swing adsorption unit, focusing on potential equipment and operational hazards

selected_agents.role: System integrity and potential cascading failure assessment

communication_strategy.information_flow: Sequential risk identification and mitigation strategy development
communication_strategy.collaboration_protocol: Integrated hazard analysis and recommendation generation

clarification_questions: What specific type of valve failed in the pressure swing adsorption unit?
Can you describe the immediate operational conditions when the valve failure occurred?
What was the pressure and temperature at the time of the valve failure?
Are there any immediate signs of damage to surrounding equipment?
